purpose: Produce the final randomized-block single-robot comparison of V5 against original M-TARE and defective V9 without reading raw bags or modifying source evidence.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only comparison after the exact composed 90-case audit and corrected V5 30-case run seal.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope.

sampling.pairing: Exact case ID, block, world, environment seed, checkpoint seed, repeat and runtime identity; three checkpoint pairs per block.

method.main: Read sealed per-case summaries, coverage-curve evidence and the seal-bound corrected-run mechanism summary only; compose corrected V5 with the same original-M-TARE and oracle cases, then apply the frozen seven-metric randomized-block analysis and deterministic paper figure/table export.
method.baseline: Original M-TARE is primary; defective V9 is a causal before/after comparator; layered GT-map remains diagnostic only.
method.statistics: Ten-block means, paired block differences, exact sign-flip tests, 10,000-sample block bootstrap intervals and Holm correction using the frozen analysis implementation.
method.fallback: None. Any non-finite metric, identity mismatch or incomplete block fails.

evidence.expected: Two exact source manifests, a seal-bound V5 mechanism manifest, seven-metric paired analyses for V5-vs-M-TARE and V5-vs-defective-V9, three statistical figures, two identity-only trajectory/topology figures and one four-method coverage-time figure as PNG/PDF, plus three result/mechanism table sets as CSV/Markdown/LaTeX, primary result summary, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.pass: All source and schedule identities are exact, the final composition is 30/30/30 over ten complete blocks, all 120 coverage curves are source-seal verified and aggregated without outcome selection, every statistic is finite, qualitative cases are fixed to env11/repeat0/checkpoint0 before outcomes, all table values are generated from sealed evidence without manual entry, and no source is mutated.
evidence.fail: Any seal/schedule/case/quota drift, incomplete block, non-finite statistic, raw-bag read, source mutation or forbidden operation.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only read-only analysis of 120 sealed case summaries; zero Gazebo, inference or training.
